dishes.name: Sol over Gudhjem
dishes.desc: Rye bread topped with smoked herring, radishes and chives, crowned with a raw egg yolk as the sun. Named after the harbour town of Gudhjem and eaten at the island's smokehouses.

dishes.name: Smoked herring
dishes.desc: Herring smoked over alder wood in the island's smokehouses, with the tall brick chimneys still dotting the harbours. Eaten warm, straight from the smoker, with rye bread.

dishes.name: Herring on rye
dishes.desc: Salt herring on dark rye bread with caramelised onions, beetroot and Bornholm mustard. The everyday island lunch, found at harbour restaurants.

dishes.name: Bornholm boiled sweets
dishes.desc: Hard sweets made by hand in small batches in Svaneke and other towns, often shaped in front of visitors. A sweet souvenir that is also a local craft.
